checks.corrected_obligation: Use the actual convex quadratic projection for ADMM; earliest-position DAG output is only a feasible witness.

checks.counterexample: Nested dense vertex samples with an empty edge relation never approximate a continuous path.
checks.corrected_obligation: Graph convergence needs a local connectivity/spanner or equivalent transition-coverage hypothesis in addition to vertex/direction density.

checks.counterexample: The sampled order A,B is infeasible but omitted order B,A is feasible.
checks.corrected_obligation: Order/layer infeasibility requires exhaustive coverage or another universal obstruction; failure of proposed orders remains UNKNOWN.

checks.counterexample: A checked invalid route witness coexists with another feasible route.
checks.corrected_obligation: Reject the proposed witness. Claim empty route fiber only with a domain-covering impossibility certificate.

checks.counterexample: Binary x=y, y=z, x!=z have feasible pairwise combinations but no global assignment.
checks.corrected_obligation: Glue fixed selected local witnesses that agree on every overlap; include the full scope of every global factor in a bag, or provide a valid decomposition theorem.

checks.counterexample: Closed incumbent costs 5; remaining OPEN lower bound is 10. min(OPEN)=10 exceeds the true optimum 5.
checks.corrected_obligation: Cover every feasible region, including closed/evaluated incumbents. With exact incumbent U and sound closures use min(U,min OPEN bounds); with cost intervals retain applicable closed-region lower endpoints.

checks.counterexample: An archive containing every state satisfies excluded-state dominance vacuously yet includes dominated states.
checks.corrected_obligation: Require internal nondominance as well as coverage of excluded states; specify whether equivalent objective vectors retain multiple contextual states.

checks.counterexample: On an empty concretization both universal TRUE and universal FALSE tests hold vacuously.
checks.corrected_obligation: Require nonempty concretizations or give EMPTY a distinct semantic disposition before applying three-valued predicates.

checks.counterexample: With mu1<=mu2 iff mu2 entails mu1, truth-table enumeration makes meet disjunction and join conjunction.
checks.corrected_obligation: Use OR for the greatest common consequence (meet) and AND for the least common strengthening (join), within a compatible context and representable licensed operations.

checks.counterexample: One deterministic validator accepts producer output 2 and rejects producer output 3.
checks.corrected_obligation: Verdict reproducibility requires identical checked artifacts and context, or independently established observational equivalence, in addition to validator determinism.

checks.counterexample: Two transactions both read/write x but add constants 1 and 2; they commute despite overlapping read/write sets.
checks.corrected_obligation: Read/write independence is sufficient, not necessary, for commutativity. Conservative serialization is valid; the converse noncommutativity theorem is not.

checks.counterexample: x'=x+u+w, terminal {0}, nominal u=0 is invariant for w=0 but w=1 leaves the terminal set.
checks.corrected_obligation: A robust MPC shift requires disturbance-consistent feedback/tube feasibility and robust terminal invariance for the declared disturbance family; a nominal sequence alone is insufficient.

checks.counterexample: For uniform X on [0,1], P(X>0)=1 although 0 is in the support and violates X>0.
checks.corrected_obligation: A probability-one claim does not imply a universal support claim without additional continuity/closed-predicate conditions or a separate universal theorem.

checks.counterexample: The constant lower bound 0 to x^2 has slope 0, valid at x=0 but invalid as a subgradient at x=1.
checks.corrected_obligation: Use a point where the bound is not tight to demonstrate that a scalar lower bound need not supply a supporting subgradient; do not reject the actual subgradient at zero.

checks.counterexample: 0 degrees Celsius equals 273.15 kelvin; a scale-only conversion maps zero to zero.
checks.corrected_obligation: Use affine x*scale+offset conversions for offset units; restrict multiplicative formula to linear unit families.

checks.counterexample: A label-equivariant rule selects every label iff a menu has at least three labels. All identical-profile alternatives are replacement-equivalent, but deleting equivalent labels changes the chosen class set.
checks.corrected_obligation: Preserve original labels and multiplicity when substituting quotient profiles, or explicitly restrict decision semantics to duplicate-invariant class menus. Original P3 THM-DS15 does not justify arbitrary menu deduplication.

checks.counterexample: A three-node tree has n messages in each child and n squared distinct root outcomes. Memory divided by node_count times max_nonroot_messages grows with n.
checks.corrected_obligation: Retain the exact sum of storage across all nodes including root. A width excluding root needs an additional bound on root output or an explicit streaming/output contract.

checks.counterexample: Two feasible hotel assignments with the same projected aggregate signature differ only in sequence c, and native table1736215 gives different cost/schedule pairs (102,30) and (103,32).
checks.corrected_obligation: Original P3's all-192-assignment aggregate benchmark needs explicit approved observation projection, or actual fixed-stratum restriction and a fresh count. Conditioning a fixed equivalence relation cannot merge previously distinct retained states.

checks.counterexample: Manifest root P entails omitted requirement P OR Q for every Boolean valuation, without any theorem that the manifest is exhaustive.
checks.corrected_obligation: Original ASS THM-ASS3 needs explicit non-entailment or independence of the omitted obligation. Arbitrary omitted requirements have no general guarantee, but some follow from listed roots.

checks.counterexample: One deterministic two-node Boolean SCC has no fixed point; another has two. Condensing either into a DAG does not define its internal solution.
checks.corrected_obligation: Original ASS14's topological induction needs a defined intra-SCC cold contract. Use verified grounded least-fixed-point semantics under finite monotone assumptions, or explicitly recompute the whole component under another justified deterministic contract.

checks.counterexample: Original P4's forty-module example states two initial blocks, four accepted nontrivial binary splits and five final blocks; the first two quantities imply six.
checks.corrected_obligation: Use three accepted splits for five final blocks. A fourth preimage or satisfiability probe may be redundant, but must not be counted as an accepted nontrivial split. Report measured operation counts.

checks.counterexample: A length-one Boolean carrier has only counts zero and one, and appending an isolated active motif leaves the fixed-length carrier.
